No forehead curler or accessories. Photorealistic premium soft 3D-render appearance, fine layered fur strands, natural paws, subtle shadows on fur, clear readable silhouette. OUTPUT exactly 1024x1536 transparent RGBA, precisely regular grid 4 columns x 6 rows, cells 256x256. ONE whole cat per cell, centered with paw ground at y=232 within each cell and safe 16px margins. No labels, lines, background or shadow plane. Every tail/paw fits inside its own cell. Same camera and lighting throughout. Each row four ordered animation phases with stable body scale:
Row1 sitting front three-quarter, looking left, center, right, center; ears and eyes naturally move.
Row2 grooming: raise front paw, lick it, rub cheek, return paw. Tongue subtle pink.
Row3 LYING as second photo: body low, front paws extended, chin lowered almost onto paws, sleepy eyelids. Fluffy tail grows from REAR of body and stands UPRIGHT behind, swaying gently left, center, right, center with curved trailing tip; do not animate whole body.
Row4 walking right side-profile slow four-legged walking cycle four phases, feet alternate, tail relaxed.
Row5 running right side-profile actual gallop four phases: gather hind legs, push off, flight stretch, land. Clearly different from walk, not merely speedup.
Row6 happy: eyes smiling, lift paws slightly, joyful head tilt, relax.
Maintain the cat identity from photos. Clean silhouettes separated by transparent space. No pink forehead object.
